> 					1098 text The squared triplet loss is designed to have the same scale as the MSE loss, allowing them to be combined in a meaningful way. By adjusting the “squared” parameter in the ACA loss, one can choose between using the standard ACA loss or its squared version.
> 					1099 text 平方三元组损失被设计为与MSE损失具有相同尺度，使它们能够以有意义的方式结合。通过调整ACA损失中的“squared”参数，可以选择使用标准ACA损失或其平方版本。
> 					1100 text Tuneable hyperparameters in ACA loss: The ACA loss has several tuneable hyperparameters that can be adjusted to improve its performance based on the specific task and dataset.
> 					1101 text ACA损失中的可调超参数：ACA损失有几个可调超参数，可根据具体任务和数据集进行调整以改进性能。
> 					1102 text • α: This is a scalar value that controls the relative weight of the regression loss and the contrastive loss. Higher values of α give more weight to the triplet loss, while lower values give more weight to the regression loss. The default value is 0.1.
> 					1103 text • α：这是一个标量值，控制回归损失与对比损失之间的相对权重。较高的α值赋予三元组损失更大权重，较低的α值赋予回归损失更大权重。默认值为0.1。
> 					1104 text • cl: This hyperparameter sets the lower threshold for the AC, which is the difference between the activity of the anchor compound and the activity of the positive compound in an ACT. If the difference is less than or equal to cl, the compounds will be considered as the positive compound in the ACT. The default value is 1.0.
> 					1105 text • cl：该超参数设置AC的下阈值，即ACT中锚点化合物活性与正例化合物活性之间的差值。如果差值小于或等于cl，则该化合物将被视为ACT中的正例化合物。默认值为1.0。
> 					1106 text • cu: This hyperparameter sets the upper threshold for the AC, which is the difference between the activity of the anchor com pound and the activity ofthe negative compound in an ACT. Ifthe difference is greater than cu, the compounds will be considered as the negative compound in the ACT. The default value is 1.0.
> 					1107 text • cu：该超参数设置AC的上阈值，即ACT中锚点化合物活性与负例化合物活性之间的差值。如果差值大于cu，则该化合物将被视为ACT中的负例化合物。默认值为1.0。
> 					1108 text • squared: This is a boolean value that determines whether the squared version of the triplet loss (combined with MSE loss) should be used or not. The default value is False.
> 					1109 text • squared：这是一个布尔值，确定是否应使用三元组损失的平方版本（与MSE损失结合）。默认值为False。
> 					1110 text • p-norm: This hyperparameter sets the norm used for the distance metric between the anchor, positive, and negative embeddings in the triplet loss. By default, the ACA loss uses the Euclidean norm (p = 2), but other values of p can also be used.
> 					1111 text • p-norm：该超参数设置三元组损失中锚点、正例和负例嵌入之间距离度量的范数。默认情况下，ACA损失使用欧几里得范数（p = 2），但也可使用其他p值。
> 					1112 text The optimal values ofthese hyperparameters may vary depending on the specific task and dataset. As illustrated in Supplementary Fig. 1b, the cliff parameters corresponding to the maximum number of mined conditional triplets vary across different datasets, reflecting differences in the distribution of activity labels. Therefore, it is advisable to perform hyperparameter tuning to determine the best values for each specific task and dataset.
> 					1113 text 这些超参数的最优值可能因具体任务和数据集而异。如补充图1b所示，对应最大挖掘条件三元组数量的悬崖参数在不同数据集间各不相同，反映了活性标签分布的差异。因此，建议进行超参数调整以确定每个特定任务和数据集的最佳值。
> 					1114 text §
> 					1115 text ACANET model architecture and training
> 					1116 text ACANET模型架构与训练
> 					1117 container
> 						1118 text We investigated four widely-used GNN backbones in the ACANET: GCN53, GIN54, GAT55, and PNA56. PNA was selected as the default backbone due to its reported superior performance in related tasks56. The message passing settings for these convolutional layers were tailored to each backbone’s architecture. For the GCN backbone, a mean aggregation approach was used to combine information from neighboring nodes. In the GAT backbone, a multi-head attention mechanism was employed, where outputs from multiple attention heads were averaged to form the final node representation. For the GIN layers, a trainable parameter ϵ was used to adjust the weight of the central node’s feature during aggregation, allowing for flexibility in balancing the influence of neighboring nodes. In the PNA backbone, multiple aggregators (“mean”, “min”, “max”, “sum”, “std”) and scalers (“identity”, “amplification”, “attenuation”) were employed to extract node features from various neighborhoods. All these GNN convolutional layers were implemented using the PyTorch Geometric57 library, ensuring efficient computation and integration within the ACANET model.
> 					1119 text 我们在ACANET中研究了四种广泛使用的GNN骨干：GCN⁵³、GIN⁵⁴、GAT⁵⁵和PNA⁵⁶。由于PNA在相关任务中报告的上级性能⁵⁶，选择其作为默认骨干。这些卷积层的消息传递设置针对每种骨干的架构量身定制。对于GCN骨干，使用均值聚合方法合并来自相邻节点的信息。在GAT骨干中，采用多头注意力机制，将多个注意力头的输出平均以形成最终节点表示。对于GIN层，使用可训练参数ε调整中心节点特征在聚合期间的权重，允许灵活平衡邻居节点的影响。在PNA骨干中，使用多种聚合器（“mean”、“min”、“max”、“sum”、“std”）和缩放器（“identity”、“amplification”、“attenuation”）从各种邻域中提取节点特征。所有这些GNN卷积层均使用PyTorch Geometric⁵⁷库实现，确保在ACANET模型内的高效计算和集成。
> 					1120 text The inputs to ACANET are small molecules with graph repre sentations (Fig. 1a), which are featurized using the 39 node features and 10 edge features (see Supplementary Table 5). The graph convolutional layers are with channel sizes of(64, 128, 256, 512). The dense layers followed a pyramid-shaped structure with 256, 128, and 32 neurons, respectively, allowing the network to learn complex representations in the early layers and progressively reduce the dimensionality towards the output layer. The default ACANET configuration did not include dropout, while Batch Normalization was applied after each graph convolutional layer to stabilize the learning process. A Global Max Pooling (GMP) layer was employed to retain the most important features from the graph, selecting the maximum value in each feature map channel (Fig. 1a).
> 					1121 text ACANET的输入是具有图表示的小分子（图1a），使用39个节点特征和10个边特征进行特征化（见补充表5）。图卷积层的通道大小为（64, 128, 256, 512）。密集层遵循金字塔结构，分别为256、128和32个神经元，允许网络在早期层学习复杂表示并朝着输出层逐步降低维度。默认的ACANET配置不包括dropout，而在每个图卷积层之后应用批归一化以稳定学习过程。采用全局最大池化（GMP）层以保留图中最重要的特征，选择每个特征图通道中的最大值（图1a）。
> 					1122 container
> 						1123 text The outputs of ACANET included the predicted activity labels and the latent vectors derived from the GMP layer, which were used for the distance calculation of ACTs as they encapsulate the most relevant information from the molecular graph. For training ACANET, a learning rate of 10−4 was fixed, and the batch size was set to 128 for all datasets. The batch size is particularly important in ACANET, as a larger batch size enables more effective sampling of HV-ACTs. An early stopping mechanism was implemented to select the best model based on the ACA loss value calculated from the monitor dataset, ensuring optimal model performance.
> 					1124 text ACANET的输出包括预测的活性标签和源自GMP层的潜在向量，后者用于ACT的距离计算，因为它们封装了分子图中最相关的信息。对于ACANET的训练，固定学习率为10⁻⁴，所有数据集的批次大小设置为128。批次大小在ACANET中尤为重要，因为较大的批次大小能够更有效地采样HV-ACT。实施了早停机制，以基于从监控数据集计算的ACA损失值选择最佳模型，确保最优模型性能。
> 					1125 text §
> 					1126 text ACANET with and without ACA across different GNNs
> 					1127 text 不同GNN下有无ACA的ACANET
> 					1128 text To verify the concept of ACA and test the effect of ACA loss, we analyzed ACANET with and without ACA across four different backbones (GCN, GIN, GAT, and PNA). A medium-sized dataset PPARδ (n = 1125) from the HSSMS collection, was used, and it was split into training, validation, and test sets in a proportion of 6:2:2. The ACANET models with ACA (MAE loss + TSM loss) and without ACA (MAE loss only) used the exact same hyperparameters except for the loss function. For the hyperparameters in the ACA loss, the awareness factor α and cliff parameters were all set to 1, following the default settings. We recorded the training history of MAE loss, the number of mined HV-ACTs (M') during training, and the RMSE performance of the validation and test sets over all training epochs. To improve the robustness of the results, we repeated the data splits 10 times with different random seeds, resulting in 10 repetitions of the PoC experiments on these different splits. The final results for PNA-based ACANET are shown in Fig. 3c and Supplementary Fig. 9, with shaded areas representing the standard deviation from 10 repetitions with different random seeds in the data splits. The impact of ACA across the four different GNN backbones is illustrated in Fig. 4 and Supplementary Fig. 19, which shows the number of mined HV-ACTs (M') for the training, validation, and test sets during training, as well as the final test RMSE performance. The best model was selected based on the validation set RMSE (Supplementary Table 6). We also mitigated hyperparameter con founding by training each backbone on the full HSSMS with a single fixed setup: all ACA hyperparameters were kept at default (cu = 1, cl = 1, α = 1). Under this shared configuration, we compared ACA and non-ACA on all 30 HSSMS datasets. Supplementary Fig. 24 shows per-dataset test-error deltas, with ACA lowering RMSE on most datasets.
> 					1129 text 为验证ACA概念并测试ACA损失的效果，我们在四种不同骨干（GCN、GIN、GAT和PNA）上分析了有无ACA的ACANET。使用来自HSSMS集合的中等规模数据集PPARδ（n = 1125），按6:2:2比例划分为训练、验证和测试集。有ACA（MAE损失 + TSM损失）和无ACA（仅MAE损失）的ACANET模型使用完全相同的超参数，仅损失函数不同。对于ACA损失中的超参数，感知因子α和悬崖参数均设为1，遵循默认设置。我们记录了所有训练轮次中MAE损失的训练历史、训练期间挖掘的HV-ACT数量（M′）以及验证和测试集的RMSE性能。为提高结果的稳健性，我们用不同随机种子重复数据划分10次，在这些不同划分上得到10次PoC实验重复。基于PNA的ACANET最终结果如图3c和补充图9所示，阴影区域表示数据划分中10次不同随机种子重复的标准差。ACA在四种不同GNN骨干上的影响如图4和补充图19所示，展示训练、验证和测试集训练期间挖掘的HV-ACT数量（M′）以及最终测试RMSE性能。最佳模型基于验证集RMSE选择（补充表6）。我们还通过在每个骨干上以单一固定设置训练来减轻超参数混淆：所有ACA超参数保持默认（cu = 1, cl = 1, α = 1）。在此共享配置下，我们在所有30个HSSMS数据集上比较了ACA和无ACA。补充图24显示每数据集测试误差差值，ACA在大多数数据集上降低RMSE。
> 					1130 text §
> 					1131 text Ablation studies on the ACA loss
> 					1132 text ACA损失的消融研究
> 					1133 text Ablation studies were conducted to investigate the impact of the ACA factor α and cliff hyperparameters in the ACA loss on PNA-based ACANET performance using the BRAF dataset from LSSNS with a stratified five-fold cross-validation repeated at least three times (Fig. 5).
> 					1134 text 为研究ACA因子α和ACA损失中悬崖超参数对基于PNA的ACANET性能的影响，使用来自LSSNS的BRAF数据集进行了消融研究，采用分层五折交叉验证重复至少三次（图5）。
> 					1135 text In the first study, the cl and cu parameters were varied while keeping α fixed at 1. The range of values for cl and cu was 0 to 4 with a step size of 0.1, ensuring that cl was less than or equal to cu. This study evaluated the effect of these changes on the number of mined labelbased conditional ACTs (M) and the RMSE performance of ACANET. The validation RMSE was averaged from five-fold cross-validation. The cliff parameters control the number of mined label-based conditional ACTs, which are crucial for predicting molecular activity. The evaluation on the other four LSSNS datasets (PLK1, IDO1, USP7, and RIP2) is shown in Supplementary Fig. 2.
> 					1136 text 在第一项研究中，在保持α固定为1的同时改变cl和cu参数。cl和cu的取值范围为0到4，步长为0.1，确保cl小于或等于cu。该研究评估了这些变化对挖掘的基于标签的条件ACT数量（M）和ACANET RMSE性能的影响。验证RMSE由五折交叉验证平均。悬崖参数控制挖掘的基于标签的条件ACT数量，这对预测分子活性至关重要。其他四个LSSNS数据集（PLK1、IDO1、USP7和RIP2）的评估见补充图2。
> 					1137 text The second study focused on the ACA factor α in the ACA loss. Here, the cl and cu parameters were fixed, and α was varied from 0.00 (no ACA) to 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50, and 1.00. This study evaluated the historical performance of ACANET over at least 800 training epochs under different α values using the BRAF dataset from LSSNS with five-fold cross-validation repeated at least three times. The results provide insights into the impact of the ACA factor α on ACANET performance and can guide the selection of appropriate values for this parameter in future applications.
> 					1138 text 第二项研究聚焦于ACA损失中的ACA因子α。在此，固定cl和cu参数，将α从0.00（无ACA）变化到0.01、0.05、0.10、0.20、0.50和1.00。该研究使用来自LSSNS的BRAF数据集，通过五折交叉验证重复至少三次，评估了不同α值下ACANET至少800个训练轮次的历史性能。结果为ACA因子α对ACANET性能的影响提供了见解，可指导未来应用中该参数适当值的选择。

> 						1299 text To evaluate the effectiveness of AC-awareness on molecular activity prediction, we conducted a benchmark study on the LSSNS collection using both MAE and MSE as the regression loss (Supplementary Table 7). We trained two versions ofthe same model: one with ACA loss and the other without. For the model with the ACA loss, we tuned the cliff parameters and the ACA factor a. Initially, we fixed the awareness factor a at its default value of 0.1 and used a “T-shape” grid search strategy to find the optimal values ofcl and cu. Specifically, we kept the cliff lower fixed at 0.1 and varied the cliff upper from 0.5 to 4.0 with a step size of0.5. Then, we used the best cliff upper value and varied the cliff lower from 0.1 to the best cliff upper value in 8 steps. After determining the optimal cliff lower and cliff upper parameters, we tuned a by performing stratified five-fold cross-validation on the training set with a range of

> 					1327 text 为评估AC感知对分子活性预测的有效性，我们在LSSNS集合上使用MAE和MSE作为回归损失进行了基准研究（补充表7）。我们训练了同一模型的两个版本：一个带ACA损失，一个不带。对于带ACA损失的模型，我们调整了悬崖参数和ACA因子a。最初，我们将感知因子a固定在其默认值0.1，使用“T形”网格搜索策略找到cl和cu的最优值。具体而言，我们将cliff lower固定在0.1，将cliff upper从0.5变化到4.0，步长为0.5。然后，使用最佳cliff upper值，将cliff lower从0.1变化到最佳cliff upper值，分8步。确定最佳cliff lower和cliff upper参数后，我们通过在训练集上进行分层五折交叉验证，在[0.0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0]范围内调整a。基于交叉验证性能选择最佳a值。相比之下，对于无ACA损失的模型，我们将a设为0.0。所有模型使用相同的批次大小（128）和学习率（10⁻⁴）训练800轮，带ACA的模型使用最佳的cl、cu和a参数。我们选择分层五折交叉验证验证集上的最佳RMSE值，并重复该过程十次以确保结果的稳定性。我们报告每个模型的平均RMSE和标准差性能。为评估带ACA损失模型性能改进的显著性，我们使用配对t检验。统计显著性水平表示如下：*p < 0.05、p < 0.01、*p < 0.001和p < 0.0001。未达到这些阈值的结果表示为“n.s.”（不显著）。

> 					1329 text Benchmarking ACANET on HSSMS datasets
> 					1330 text HSSMS数据集上的ACANET基准测试
> 					1331 container
> 						1332 text We assess the performance of ACANET on the HSSMS benchmark datasets. These datasets serve as a representative set ofmixed-scaffold datasets for exposing the limitations of molecular machine learning with 
> 						1333 container
> 							1334 text A
> 							1335 text C
> 							1336 container
> 								1337 text S 19
> 							1338 text .
> 							1339 text T
> 							1340 text o
> 						1341 text  compare the benchmark results with those obtained using off-the-shelf machine learning models for molecular activity prediction, we compared ACA-equipped ACANET with the following models: the graph-based GAT, GCN, AFP, and MPNN methods (without ACA); the SMILES-based Transformer, CNN, and LSTM; and ECFP4 fingerprint-based MLP, KNN, GBM, RF, and SVM. The statistical significance of the performance difference between ACANET with ACA and the off-the-shelf models was determined using the paired t-test with a significance level of 0.05. We further compared ACA with two classical quantitative SAR baselines, namely a scaffold-based Free–Wilson model and a descriptor-based PLS regressor (Supplementary Note 2). The Free–Wilson comparison was restricted to the dominant Bemis–Murcko scaffold subset, consistent with its singlescaffold assumption, whereas PLS was evaluated on the full HSSMS datasets using standard molecular descriptors. ACA consistently outperformed both baselines, supporting its advantage over both classical SAR and modern machine learning approaches. Additionally, we performed a paired t-test to assess the statistical significance of the performance improvement of ACANET with ACA compared to ACANET without ACA.
> 					1342 text 我们评估了ACANET在HSSMS基准数据集上的性能。这些数据集作为暴露分子机器学习AC局限性的混合骨架数据集代表集¹⁹。为将基准结果与使用现成机器学习模型获得的分子活性预测结果进行比较，我们将装备ACA的ACANET与以下模型比较：基于图的GAT、GCN、AFP和MPNN方法（无ACA）；基于SMILES的Transformer、CNN和LSTM；以及基于ECFP4指纹的MLP、KNN、GBM、RF和SVM。ACANET与现成模型之间性能差异的统计显著性使用显著性水平为0.05的配对t检验确定。我们进一步将ACA与两种经典定量SAR基线比较，即基于骨架的Free-Wilson模型和基于描述符的PLS回归器（补充说明2）。Free-Wilson比较限于主导的Bemis-Murcko骨架子集，与其单一骨架假设一致，而PLS在完整HSSMS数据集上使用标准分子描述符评估。ACA始终优于两种基线，支持其相对于经典SAR和现代机器学习方法的优势。此外，我们进行了配对t检验，以评估带ACA的ACANET与不带ACA的ACANET相比性能改进的统计显著性。

For hyperparameter optimization in ACA loss, we followed these steps: First, we fixed the awareness factor a at its default value of 0.1 and used a “T-shape” grid search strategy to find the optimal values of cliff lower and cliff upper (Supplementary Fig. 3a). Specifically, we kept the cliff lower fixed at 0.1 and varied the cliff upper from 0.5 to 4.0 with a step size of 0.5. Then, we used the best cliff upper value and varied the cliff lower from 0.1 to the best cliff upper value in 8 steps. After determining the optimal cliff lower and cliff upper parameters, we tuned a by performing stratified five-fold cross-validation on the training set with a range of [0., 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.] (Supplementary Fig. 3b). The best a value was chosen based on training set cross-validation performance (Supplementary Fig. 5), the training set cross-validation performance of ACANET model with and without ACA is shown in Supplementary Table 8. > 						1369 text  as used by van Tilborg et al.19. The results are shown in Supplementary Fig. 6. We adopted an as-fair-as-possible strategy by conducting hyperparameter searches within comparable ranges to enable fair comparisons with other baselines (Supplementary Table 10).
> 					1370 text 为在所有数据集上训练ACANET，我们使用批次大小128和学习率10⁻⁴。对于ACA损失中的超参数优化，我们遵循以下步骤：首先，将感知因子a固定在其默认值0.1，使用“T形”网格搜索策略找到cliff lower和cliff upper的最优值（补充图3a）。具体而言，保持cliff lower固定为0.1，将cliff upper从0.5变化到4.0，步长为0.5。然后，使用最佳cliff upper值，将cliff lower从0.1变化到最佳cliff upper值，分8步。确定最佳cliff lower和cliff upper参数后，我们通过在训练集上进行分层五折交叉验证，在[0., 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.]范围内调整a（补充图3b）。基于训练集交叉验证性能选择最佳a值（补充图5），带和不带ACA的ACANET模型训练集交叉验证性能见补充表8。我们将ACA损失中的所有其他参数，如squared（squared = False）和p-norm（p = 2），设置为其默认值。在ACANET的最终训练阶段，我们采用基于嵌套分层五折交叉验证验证集的早停来选择最佳模型。为在外部测试集上预测，我们对嵌套交叉验证中五个子模型的预测取平均。性能使用整体测试集（RMSE）和悬崖特定测试集（RMSE_cliff）上的RMSE指标评估，如van Tilborg等人¹⁹所用。结果见补充图6。我们通过在可比较范围内进行超参数搜索，采取了尽可能公平的策略，以与其他基线进行公平比较（补充表10）。
> 					1371 text To further assess the generalizability of ACA, we evaluated ACA-NET under more stringent data-splitting strategies on the HSSMS collection (see Supplementary Note 3). First, in a Bemis–Murcko scaffold–held-out split (20% scaffolds assigned to the test set), ACA improved performance over the non-ACA baseline on all 30 targets. Second, we constructed an even more challenging independent test split by removing any molecule whose fingerprint, scaffold, or SMILES similarity to any training compound exceeded 0.90, producing a cliffrich test set (mean 76.8% cliffs). Under this stringent setting, ACA achieved lower RMSE on 28 of 30 targets, demonstrating that ACA generalizes to unseen cliffs and remains beneficial even when all relevant cliffs occur exclusively at test time.
> 					1372 text 为进一步评估ACA的泛化能力，我们在HSSMS集合上更严格的数据划分策略下评估了ACA-NET（见补充说明3）。首先，在Bemis-Murcko骨架留出划分（20%骨架分配给测试集）中，ACA在所有30个靶点上优于无ACA基线。其次，我们通过移除与任何训练化合物的指纹、骨架或SMILES相似性超过0.90的任何分子，构建了一个更具挑战性的独立测试划分，产生了一个富含悬崖的测试集（平均76.8%悬崖）。在这一严格设置下，ACA在30个靶点中的28个上实现了更低的RMSE，证明ACA可泛化到未见悬崖，并且即使当所有相关悬崖仅出现在测试时仍然有益。
> 					1373 text §
> 					1374 text Benchmarking ACANET on ADMET datasets
> 					1375 text ADMET数据集上的ACANET基准测试
> 					1376 text To further evaluate our method for predicting other molecular properties such as ADMET, we tested ACANET on the 10 ADMET benchmark datasets (Supplementary Table 4) for property delta prediction. As molecular property delta (the property difference between two molecules) prediction can assess model performance on “property cliffs”, we compared the model performance with established methods such as ECFP-based RF and LightGBM ML models, and the GNN-based Chem Prop and Deep Delta models for ADMET property differences prediction. To predict the delta values using our method, we trained the ACANET model on the absolute ADMET properties and inferred the property differences on the test set by predicting the absolute values. During training, the ACA loss hyperparameters cl, cu, and α were optimized using the same strategy as HSSMS benchmarking. An example ofhyperparameter search for the Caco-2 Permeability dataset is shown in Supplementary Fig. 4. Using the same data split method and delta prediction evaluation as the established methods, the final model performance ofdelta RMSE from the 5 × 10-fold cross-validation results is shown in Supplementary Fig. 8.
> 					1377 text 为进一步评估我们的方法预测其他分子性质（如ADMET），我们在10个ADMET基准数据集（补充表4）上测试了ACANET进行性质差值预测。由于分子性质差值（两个分子之间的性质差异）预测可评估模型在“性质悬崖”上的性能，我们将模型性能与已建立的方法比较，如基于ECFP的RF和LightGBM ML模型，以及基于GNN的ChemProp和DeepDelta模型用于ADMET性质差异预测。为使用我们的方法预测差值，我们在绝对ADMET性质上训练ACANET模型，并通过预测绝对值在测试集上推断性质差异。训练期间，ACA损失超参数cl、cu和α使用与HSSMS基准相同的策略进行优化。Caco-2渗透性数据集的超参数搜索示例见补充图4。使用与已建立方法相同的数据划分方法和差值预测评估，来自5 × 10折交叉验证的最终模型差值RMSE性能见补充图8。
> 					1378 text §
> 					1379 text Extending the ACA for activity cliff classification
> 					1380 text 扩展ACA用于活性悬崖分类
> 					1381 container
> 						1382 text In addition to quantitative SAR, predicting pairs of AC molecules is another important challenge related to AC. This task involves classifying whether a pair of similar compounds forms an AC or not6,36,43. In this section, we extend ACA to AC classification in matched molecular pairs.
> 					1383 text 除定量SAR外，预测AC分子对是另一个与AC相关的重要挑战。该任务涉及分类一对相似化合物是否形成AC⁶³⁶⁴³。在本节中，我们将ACA扩展到匹配分子对中的AC分类。
> 					1384 container
> 						1385 text An AC pair can be represented by an MMP, where the two molecules share the same core structure but have different substituents. Following Park et al.43 and Tamura et al.44, molecule pairs were decomposed using the algorithm by Hussain et al.59, with each fragment treated as a subgraph. The representation of the molecule is the concatenation of its core and substituent representations encoded by GNN. Most deep learning methods currently use cross-entropy loss for AC prediction, without explicitly emphasizing the substituents that contain rich SAR knowledge. To develop ACA for classification tasks, these AC pairs have already been pre-provided and do not need to be constructed in the batch. We use a simple yet effective contrastive learning strategy to push the features of ACs apart and bring the features of non-ACs closer. Specifically, for a given MMP consisting of molecule A and molecule B, we calculate the paired contrastive loss

> 						1392 text  to maximize the distance between A and B if the MMP is an AC, and minimize the distance otherwise:

> 					1496 text §
> 					1497 text Reporting summary
> 					1498 text Further information on research design is available in the Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary linked to this article.
> 					1499 text §
> 					1500 text Data availability
> 					1501 container
> 						1502 text The data that support the findings of this study, including the 9 small sample size narrow scaffold (LSSNS) datasets, the 30 large-sample size mixed scaffold (HSSMS) datasets, the 3 MMP datasets and 10 ADMET datasets (available from https://github.com/bidd-group/MPCD), are available from Zenodo60 and from the corresponding authors upon request. In addition, datasets are being made available via the Molecular Property Cliff Task (https://tdcommons.ai/single pred tasks/ MPC/) in Therapeutics Data Commons61 (https://tdcommons. ai). Source data are provided with this paper.
> 					1503 text §
> 					1504 text Code availability
> 					1505 container
> 						1506 text Codes used in this study are available from the corresponding author upon request. In addition, the source code and Jupyter notebooks are available from Zenodo62, including PyTorch and TensorFlow 2.x implementations of the ACA loss. A Molecular Property Cliff Task has been introduced to the Therapeutics Data Commons61 (https:// tdcommons.ai/single pred tasks/MPC/), allowing programmatic access to the data used in the paper. A tutorial has been included in the TDC-2 Tutorials (https://github.com/mims-harvard/TDC/blob/main README.md).
